by {
  rcases h with ⟨hle, hsup⟩,
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hba⟩ := hsup,
  use [b, hb, hba],
  have hne : a ≠ 0 := by contrapose! hε; exact eq_zero_of_neg_lt (neg_pos.mpr hε),
  have hapos : 0 < a := by rw [add_right_cancel_iff, neg_neg]; exact hne,
  refine lt_trans (a - ε) _,
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_sub_cancel'],
  exact hapos,
  exact hle b
}
